create.name: John Weddepohl
create.bio:
John Weddepohl is a South African-born teacher of Atma Vidya, the Self-knowledge of the Upanishads and Vedanta, who also goes by the name Siddharthan. He started teaching yoga in Johannesburg as a teenager in 1969, but his first school was closed under apartheid, and for years he worked as a singer, songwriter and composer for film and television. After travelling to India in the mid-2000s he met the guru who initiated him, spent around seven years studying in Tiruvannamalai, and was asked to pass the teaching on.

He calls his approach ISHTAM, a name he gave it in 2011, and it rests on three strands: Atma Vidya, traditional study of the scriptures that points to the Self behind the word 'I'; Ishta Mala, a short daily yoga sequence; and Siddha Kriya, a breathing method from the Tamil Siddha tradition. From a home studio in Byron Bay, New South Wales, he gives private and group classes and six-session mentoring packages, and with his wife, the yoga teacher Rachel Zinman, he runs Sundaram Online Ashram, a membership with weekly live classes, Upasana meditation, pranayama and recorded Self-knowledge courses.

courses.title: One-on-One Mentoring with John Weddepohl
courses.description: Six one-hour sessions with John, online or in Byron Bay, combining Self-knowledge study with Siddha Kriya breathing shaped to the student, plus text support between sessions through a Slack group.

courses.title: Sundaram Online Ashram membership
courses.description: The online membership John runs with Rachel Zinman: a library of recorded Self-knowledge courses, Upasana meditations and yoga classes, with weekly live sessions and a members' community on the higher tiers.
courses.price: $29 AUD a month (Sunflower) or $49 AUD a month (Lotus)
